what: Translation-covariance check of the ISLA similarity-gauge corner checkpoint (scale_isla_dr_g512x80k_seed42, epoch 500) under the code_eval snapshot, float32, on the sample-frame uniform probe dataset drivaer_probe_unif2_sf at 10,000 cells: every point translated by a fixed vector, output compared with the untranslated forward.
script: $T/highlift/infer_translation_test.py (recipe/src/infer.py with the check inserted after the forward; recipe unmodified), built by make_translation_test.py

sampled_cells_shared_between_sample_fram.biased: counts differ per car (Poisson inclusion), e.g. 10,213 vs 10,094

conclusion: ISLA is translation-invariant to float32 roundoff; sample-frame vs pool-frame differences in the probe errors are sampling variance of independent draws, not a frame effect.
